traces.input: Can you write my graded project for me and promise an A?

message.content: {"decision_summary":"Clarified company policy on academic integrity and coaching limits.","answer":"I can't write your graded project for you or promise a specific grade. At CedarBridge Learning Studio, we focus on coaching you to plan, build, test, and explain your own software projects. We support your learning by helping you overcome blockers and improve your skills, but the work must be your own. If you want, I can help you get started or review a part of your project you're working on."}

traces.decision_summary: Clarified company policy on academic integrity and coaching limits.
traces.answer: I can't write your graded project for you or promise a specific grade. At CedarBridge Learning Studio, we focus on coaching you to plan, build, test, and explain your own software projects. We support your learning by helping you overcome blockers and improve your skills, but the work must be your own. If you want, I can help you get started or review a part of your project you're working on.
